prompt: Create a high-fidelity portrait mobile web app UI composition for a household cleaning app named Doubtfire. This is a designed app surface, not a poster and not a phone mockup. Render only the flat 390 x 844 screen. Structure, top to bottom: a clean white header with the small wordmark Doubtfire at left and compact language and account controls at right; a concise opening area with the exact headline Ready when you are. in large deep-navy rounded sans text and the exact supporting line Choose a routine and start.; one vivid cobalt primary action with the exact label Start cleaning; a section label Routines with three real choices Weekly, Fortnightly, and Quarterly; and a familiar fixed bottom navigation Home, History, Settings with Home active. Composition option 3, Color Islands: keep the ground white and bright. Make three large softly shaped color islands integrated with the routine list: pale sky-blue for Weekly, pale mint for Fortnightly, and pale lilac for Quarterly. Let the islands have subtly different silhouettes or corner profiles. Use a compact cobalt action that bridges the opening headline and first island. Add a small warm coral dot only as a decorative counterpoint, never as a warning. Use generous negative space and asymmetric alignment while preserving clear touch targets. Fresh, light, modern, calm household care. No scores, percentages, progress rings, task debt, warnings, fractions, gamification, copied logos, branded device imagery, people, or fake claims.
